statusCodesIntro:
When you change your status, Medut dials these codes on each account, one after the other, so you hear the PBX confirm:
• Available: queue log-out (DND off after Do not disturb)
• Ready: queue log-in (DND off after Do not disturb)
• Do not disturb: DND on, then queue log-out
